visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy brown hair stands in an indoor room, wearing a pink strapless mini dress with white fur trim, white bunny ears, and pink opera-length gloves. She holds a large, fluffy white plush bunny with big blue eyes. To her right is a red Supreme-branded arcade machine, and to her left, a shelf displays LEGO Technic boxes. The lighting is bright and even. (2) After a quick cut, the woman's outfit changes to a red, one-piece Christmas-themed bodysuit with white pom-poms on the chest and a thin white collar. She now wears red reindeer antler headbands and holds a different, brown plush toy wearing a dark blue vest. The background remains identical. (3) A third outfit change shows her in a red Santa-style tube top and a short red skirt with white fur edging, paired with red and white bunny ears. She holds a small brown teddy bear plush. She smiles at the camera, shifting her body slightly to show off the outfit as the video ends.
